name: AI review - 3. Propose rules from a document

parameters.query:
SELECT d.id AS document_id, d.title, d.kind, d.product_types, d.requirement_ids, c.page, c.content
FROM kb_documents d JOIN kb_chunks c ON c.document_id = d.id
WHERE d.source_key = $1
ORDER BY c.chunk_index;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ message: 'No document with that sourceKey. Upload it first.' }) }}

={{ JSON.stringify({ status: 'started', sourceKey: $('Validate request').first().json.sourceKey, batches: $json.of, chunksRead: $json.chunksRead, chunksTotal: $json.chunksTotal, next: 'GET /webhook/ai/rules?status=proposed when it finishes' }) }}
